node.label: Reduced aspartoacylase activity in cultured fibroblasts
node.definition: Activity of aspartoacylase below the lower limit of normal in cultured fibroblasts. Aspartoacylase (EC 3.5.1.15), also called aminoacylase-2, is an enzyme that hydrolyzes N-acetyl-L-aspartic acid (NAA) to aspartate and acetate.

evidence.snippet: Canavan disease: Reduced aspartoacylase activity in cultured fibroblasts (frequency 22/22) [PCS]
